result.title: Adaptive Observation Control for Active Visual Recognition
result.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation in ACCV 2026
result.summary: Visual recognition models usually process a fixed view under a fixed computation budget, although images often benefit from different scales and amounts of spatial evidence. Active vision can adapt by observing a coarse scene and then selecting informative fixations, but the public AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S pipeline still fixes both field of view and observation count. We extend this fixed-step recognizer with a controllable observation interface that adapts both the field of view and the number of fixations to the input. Specifically, the model predicts a per-fixation scale that sets its field of view, refines each selected crop with optional scale-gated foveation and a residual high-resolution detail-token branch, and uses label-grounded stop heads for input-dependent early termination. Experiments across fine-grained benchmarks, full ImageNet-1K, and ImageNet-A/R-derived classification splits show that the interface remains competitive with fixed-step references while exposing a controllable observation budget. The same checkpoint enables threshold-controlled accuracy-compute trade-offs without per-threshold retraining. On sequential ImageNet-1K, the learned stop rule outperforms fixed-step truncation of the same checkpoint, sustaining 81.9% top-1 using 2.45 of the four focus steps and exceeding three-step truncation at lower cost. On each benchmark, a variant combining scale control and detail-token fusion achieves the highest accuracy among the tested component-added non-exit variants. Our code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/LI-Dikai.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为主动视觉识别提出可控制的观察接口：预测每次注视的尺度以决定视野，配合尺度门控 foveation 与高分辨率细节 token 分支细化裁剪，并用标签监督的 stop head 实现输入相关的提前停止，使同一 checkpoint 可在不同阈值下调节准确率与计算量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其自适应注视次数、尺度选择与停止头对应 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 和动态计算预算的问题，可作为证据筛选与停止决策评价目标的参考；但工作面向图像分类而非多模态推理，能否迁移到 latent 推理需核查。
